proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.concentrationOverride = "not_required"
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants access to an existing spell but changes how that granted cast is maintained. The current spell-access surface can override DC and targeting, but it cannot say that a normally concentration-based spell no longer requires concentration when cast through the item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration"

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.durationBoundToGrantedSpell
proposed_widenings.justification: The granted Detect Thoughts cast persists only while a separate granted Scrying cast remains active. The current surface has no way to express cross-spell lifecycle coupling between two spell-access grants on the same item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "but it ends if the Scrying spell ends"

notes: MagicItemRecord and grant_spell_access already cover legendary attunement items, fixed-DC granted casts, and spell-sensor-based targeting. The missing pieces are both surface-level modifiers on the granted Detect Thoughts cast, so this is surface_widening rather than structural_widening or atom_widening.
